boundary_condition: This applies only to flight departure time-of-day selection; it does not set the destination, travel date, return time, route, cabin class, or price limit.
condition: When searching for flights and choosing a departure time of day, if the itinerary does not impose a different schedule constraint.
default_action: Prefer or filter for flights departing at night.
exception_condition: If the user specifies another departure window or nighttime flights are unavailable or incompatible with the current itinerary, follow the stated schedule constraint instead of defaulting to night.
name: Prefers nighttime departures for flights
rationale: Three independent flight-task instruction_ids contain requests or selections for “night time” flights. The examples consistently support a reusable synthetic default toward nighttime flight departures, scoped to departure-time selection rather than to any one route or date.

source_evidence.contribution: User selects “the night time flight” and says it “works best for me,” with “night time” annotated as flight_search.time_of_day.
User directly requests the time of day: “I want to fly at night time,” with “night time” annotated as flight_search.time_of_day.
User gives an approximate departure window: “Somewhere around night time,” with “night time” annotated as flight_search.time_of_day.

source_examples.user_utterance: I think I'll go with the economy non-stop and the night time flight I think works best for me.
I want to fly at night time.
